sentences.text: Shri R.K. Raghuwanshi, learned counsel for the applicants.
Shri Santosh Yadav, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The revision is admitted for final hearing.
Let record of the Courts below be called for.
Also heard on I.A. No.1181/2019, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicants have been convicted for offence punishable under Sections 7 (i) R/w 16 (1) (a) (i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced them to undergo R.I. for six months each with fine of Rs.4,000/-each and Section 7 (iii) Rules 50 R/w 16 (1) (a) (ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced them to undergo R.I. for three months each with fine of Rs.1,000/-
each, with default stipulations as mentioned in the impugned judgment.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the case.
They were enlarged on bail during the trial and appeal and they did not misuse the liberty granted to them.
They have deposited the entire fine amount before the trial Court.
Under such circumstances, the applicants pray for bail and suspension of execution of jail sentence.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Keeping in view the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the applicants may be enlarged on bail,
consequently, I.A. No.1181/2019 is hereby allowed.
The substansive jail sentence of the applicants is hereby suspended subject to deposit the fine amount.

The applicants Babu Khan and Govind Kukreja be enlarged on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a surety bond each in the like amount to the satisfaction of THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Babu Khan &
anr. Vs. The State of M.P.) the trial Court to appear before the Registry of this Court on 25.03.2019 and on further dates as may be fixed by the Registry till the disposal of the case.
